remarks: This session's proxy could not reach fabkerala.gov.in (Department of Factories & Boilers, Kerala — the primary authority for the Factory License) on any of 9+ attempts across its home page, FAQ, user-guides, FABOS login portal, Kerala Factories Rules PDF, and four 2025 Government Order/notification PDFs, nor kswift.kerala.gov.in (the actual K-SWIFT filing portal), nor labour.kerala.gov.in, compose.kerala.gov.in, dic.kerala.gov.in, or lc.kerala.gov.in. All failed identically with 'Connection reset by peer', and the proxy's own diagnostic log (recentRelayFailures) recorded these as 'ws_closed_mid_exchange' (tunnel to the egress proxy closed before the TLS handshake completed) for fabkerala.gov.in specifically, alongside many *other* states' equivalent factory/labour-department hosts (e.g. tsfactories.cgg.gov.in, pblabour.gov.in, ciflabour.assam.gov.in, ifp.gujarat.gov.in, singlewindow.jk.gov.in, eodb.py.gov.in) failing the same way in the same time window — indicating this is a broader network/proxy-side condition affecting many Indian state-government NIC-hosted sites from this session, not a deliberate block specific to Kerala's sites. Per the spec, these were excluded rather than guessed at or filled in from WebSearch snippets.

Because the state's own primary portal was unreachable, only two verified sources could be produced for this pilot: the central NSWS homepage and the KSIDC (Kerala State Industrial Development Corporation) homepage — both of which loaded with real, non-shell content and are legitimate state/central government(-undertaking) properties, but neither is a page dedicated specifically to the Factory License process; they establish that K-SWIFT is Kerala's designated single-window channel for it without directly showing its content.

Several other central .gov.in candidates (india.gov.in, pib.gov.in, dgfasli.gov.in/DGOSH, prd.kerala.gov.in, www.kerala.gov.in) did load successfully with real content this session, but were deliberately left out of verifiedSources because, on inspection, none of them carried content specific enough to 'getting a Factory License in Kerala' to justify inclusion — they are the state portal, the central Ministry of Labour's central OSH/Factories-Act body, and Kerala's general Public-Relations/Gazette-adjacent department, respectively, none of which surfaced a Kerala-FAL-specific page in this session's fetches.

A WebSearch snippet also surfaced a Kerala Kaumudi news report (not independently verified, and excluded per the spec's rule against non-government sources) that the Kerala Legislative Assembly passed the 'SARAL Kerala Bill 2026' on 2026-10-30, intended to replace K-SWIFT as the state's business-approval single-window system; if true, this means the K-SWIFT references found in this exercise (and in the briefly-reachable KSIDC homepage) may be mid-transition to a new portal name/URL that could not be confirmed from any government source this session.

No candidate URL that only returned an empty JS shell or unrelated content was listed as a verified source; two such cases (labour.gov.in, legislative.gov.in) are recorded in `excluded` per the spec's explicit guidance rather than cited as real sources.
